name: pair_device
description: Pair a single physical device by its known address -- immediate, not staged, takes effect right away. INSTEON only for now; any other protocol returns guidance to use the vendor's manual pairing procedure instead. This drives the PLM's serial hardware directly, so it cannot run at the same time as get_dev_links_table/compare_device_links/get_all_plm_links/quick_plm_sanity_check or a second call to itself -- if one of those is already in progress this returns an immediate {"error": ...} rather than waiting; just retry shortly.

protocol.description: The device's protocol, e.g. "insteon". Only "insteon" is currently supported for automatic pairing.

device_address.description: The device's known address, required for insteon pairing.
